search.query: | mstats avg("memwatch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | 1=1 | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("memwatch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*avail_pct*","*swap_used_pct*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("memwatch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*pswpin*","*pswpout*") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("memwatch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*oom_kill_total*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("memwatch.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*slab_top_kb*" | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
